test_title: PYST 04: SSC Stenographer - General Intelligence & Reasoning (Held On: 11 Dec 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. You have to consider the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. You have to decide which of the given conclusions logically follow/s from the given

statements.

**Statements:**

Some nouns are pronouns.

All pronouns are adjectives.

No adjective is an adverb.

**Conclusions:**

(1): No pronoun is an adverb.

(2): At least some nouns are adverbs.
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a942ab007751335f93b0525701dbcdb6974c3c85a4bd0fdabddd1d6eab4cefb2.png] 

Conclusions:

(1) No pronoun is an adverb → Follow (As all pronouns are adjectives and no adjective is an adverb. As whole pronouns comes in adjectives which cannot be adverb, therefore it is true)

(2) At least some nouns are adverbs → Does not follow (As some nouns are pronouns, all pronouns are adjectives and no adjective is an adverb. So it is possible but not definite)

∴ Here, Only conclusion (1) follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4"
